relations.text: DIRECTVの残りの持分をTPGに売却した
relations.text_en: Sold its remaining DIRECTV interest to TPG

source.label: AT&T 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: On July 2, 2025, we sold our interest in DIRECTV to TPG Capital (TPG).

relations.text: DriveNetsの16.6%を持つ持分法投資先である

source.label: AT&T 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We hold a 16.6 % interest in DriveNets, which designs and builds high-scale networking solutions for service providers and AI infrastructures.

relations.text: 光ファイバー網を提供する合弁会社ギガパワーの50%を持つ
relations.text_en: Holds a 50% interest in the joint venture Gigapower

source.label: AT&T 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We hold a 50 % interest in our joint venture Gigapower, LLC (Gigapower), which provides a fiber network in select areas to internet service providers and other businesses across the United States.

relations.text: エコースターから約23,000百万ドルで周波数免許を購入することに合意した
relations.text_en: Agreed to buy FCC licenses from EchoStar for approximately $23,000

source.label: AT&T 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: On August 25, 2025, we agreed to purchase FCC licenses in the 600 MHz and 3.45 GHz bands from EchoStar for approximately $23,000, subject to certain adjustments.

companies.name: ルーメン・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: ルーメンの個人向け光ファイバー事業の大部分を5,750百万ドルで取得することに合意した
relations.text_en: Agreed to acquire substantially all of Lumen’s Mass Markets fiber business for $5,750 in cash

source.label: AT&T 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: On May 21, 2025, we agreed to acquire substantially all of Lumen’s Mass Markets fiber business for $5,750 in cash, subject to purchase price adjustments.
